items.title: 23 built-in steps
items.text: Secrets, workflows, dead code, duplicates, nesting, links, spelling, architecture and more.

items.title: One settings file
items.text: check-pipeline.toml picks the steps, groups them for CI and holds each check's rules.

items.title: Your own checks
items.text: A Python function that takes the codebase and returns findings is a step.

items.title: Your tools
items.text: SwiftLint, ruff or any command whose lines name a file and a line.

items.title: Tested by mistakes
items.text: Samples hold a planted mistake for every rule, and the checks must find exactly those.

items.title: Made for GitHub
items.text: Every finding becomes a note beside its line in the pull request.
